defs.name: Line-splitting pass
defs.cla: Invitation to act created when a receiver stands beyond an opponent line and the segment between carrier and receiver clears every defender on that line.
defs.detect: lane_clearance > 0.8 m AND >= 1 opponent x between carrier and receiver AND receiver ahead of carrier - 2 m

defs.name: Through-ball timing run
defs.cla: Invitation created when a runner can reach space behind the last line before the covering defender can rotate his line of sight onto the ball.
defs.detect: target = receiver + 5 m up-pitch AND lane_clearance > 0.8 m AND target ahead of the deepest opponent - 6 m

defs.name: Third-man run
defs.cla: Invitation created when a first pass fixes a defender and a third player arrives into the vacated seam; the carrier never plays the runner directly.
defs.detect: >= 2 mates ahead of the carrier AND the nearest-ahead lane clears AND the furthest-ahead mate is 8 m beyond him

defs.name: Give-and-go
defs.cla: Invitation created when the wall pass and the return lane both stay open across the presser's turn time.
defs.detect: nearest mate <= 14 m AND outward lane clears AND return lane clears at carrier + 4 m up-pitch

defs.name: Switch of play
defs.cla: Invitation created when the opponent block has compressed to one side faster than it can slide back across.
defs.detect: lateral separation >= 12 m AND lane_clearance > 0.8 m

defs.name: Driving run into space
defs.cla: Invitation created when the space in front of the carrier is larger than the distance any defender can close inside the carrier's acceleration window.
defs.detect: clearance to a point 9 m up-pitch > 0.4 m AND no opponent within 4 m of that point

defs.name: 1v1 dribble
defs.cla: Invitation created when exactly one defender is engaged and his line-of-sight rotation rate cannot cover both feet of the carrier.
defs.detect: exactly one opponent within 5 m AND clearance to a point 6 m past him > 0.4 m

defs.name: Shot
defs.cla: Invitation created when the angle subtended by the posts and the clearance of the strike lane jointly exceed the keeper's covering rate.

ensemble.note: per-affordance taken / available-but-not-taken counts across the paired ensemble, team A

summary.note: showcase counts are for the single sampled possession; the ensemble block is the claim
